testsuite.name: gg.rsmod.plugins.content.quests.tab.QuestTabTests

testcase.name: a long place reads in full, as its short form or cut - never past its room
groups use the existing choice data and the Quests tab lists every group, quest and requirement
the classic quest list 190 fits the panel box of the Quests tab, nothing cut off at the right
every points page names where the points are spent
emblem line shows None or the owned tier with its points
Info window fits the fixed-mode main screen, the list fits its well, every page fits its boxes
every Deadman line fits next to its title, the chest spot within three lines
breach time notations
Info pages carry the numbers of the rules they explain
groups not chosen yet show the Quest Tutor note and every option locked
chest line - Active over its spot, else the time until the next one
six Deadman lines fit the fixed-mode panel without scrolling
point lines read exactly the balances the three stores spend
tabs left to right as the approved design - Quests, Deadman, Deadman Tasks, Drops & Collection Log
chosen tab is stored on the account and a new account starts on Deadman
accounts from before the choices get no note
the gameframe quest icon stays the Deadman skull after clientscript 1766 redraws the tab strip
N289 - a group whose quests are all yours reads a green Unlocked, a chosen group Chosen, an open group Pick 1
chosen option is marked with its unlock, finished quests read Unlocked, the rest Locked
a point row opens Info on those points and never a store, the emblem row Info on the emblem
the Info window close is guarded
